cb6ab21cfc7d3ccd.description: About the Role Swatch is seeking a dedicated and experienced Store Manager to oversee its retail operations in Makkah and Jeddah. This full-time role requires a professional with over 10 years of experience, responsible for the comprehensive management of the store, ensuring commercial performance, customer satisfaction, and adherence to brand standards. Key Responsibilities Achieve and exceed store sales targets and commercial objectives, driving profitability and maximizing performance. Lead, motivate, coach, and develop the store team, setting clear expectations and monitoring individual and team sales performance. Ensure consistently high customer service standards, building and maintaining customer relationships, and managing feedback and concerns. Plan store staffing and floor coverage according to business requirements, managing schedules and coordinating recruitment with HR. Ensure employees maintain strong product knowledge and complete required training, reinforcing learning on the sales floor. Maintain overall accountability for effective daily store operations, ensuring accurate completion of front and back-office activities. Manage inventory and stock levels, ensuring accurate execution of stock movements, conducting inventories, and investigating discrepancies. Execute Swatch visual merchandising guidelines, maintaining strong product presentation and store cleanliness. Ensure security, loss prevention, and risk control measures are followed, protecting company assets and merchandise. Manage controllable store expenses and identify opportunities for cost efficiency. Maintain awareness of local market conditions, customer trends, and competitors, identifying opportunities for business development. Monitor and report store sales performance and key retail KPIs, providing timely updates to the Retail Manager. Qualifications and Requirements A minimum of 10 years of experience in retail management. Proven ability to drive sales and profitability in a retail environment. Strong leadership and team development skills. Demonstrated understanding of retail KPIs and commercial actions. Experience in inventory management and operational excellence. Commitment to delivering high standards of customer experience and visual merchandising. Working Relationships The Store Manager will work closely with the Retail Manager, Assistant Store Manager, Sales Associates, and various internal departments including HR, Finance, Marketing, and Logistics. External interactions will include customers, mall management, and approved service providers. Key Challenges This role involves balancing aggressive commercial objectives with maintaining Swatch's customer experience standards. Key challenges include converting customer traffic into sustainable sales, maintaining team motivation in a fast-paced environment, and adapting store execution to changing market conditions while adhering to company governance and delegated authority. Application Process Salary for this position will be discussed during the interview process. Qualified candidates are encouraged to apply.

cbf41f27c91c897d.description: About Systra SYSTRA is a global engineering and consultancy group specializing in public transport and sustainable mobility. With over 10,300 employees, SYSTRA designs safe and sustainable transport solutions globally, focusing on social inclusion and access to essential services. For 65 years, the Group has supported cities and regions in developing, improving, and modernizing infrastructure and transport systems throughout the project lifecycle, from design to maintenance. Operating in over 80 countries, SYSTRA is committed to supporting clients in their digital, ecological, and energy transitions. The Role: Power Supply Engineer (Saudi National) SYSTRA is seeking a Power Supply Engineer to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves supporting the delivery of traction power supply systems for major railway and metro infrastructure projects. The successful candidate will ensure the development of safe, reliable, and high-performing power systems that meet operational and project requirements. This position is open to Saudi Nationals and requires over 10 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Oversee Traction Power Supply System construction activities, ensuring compliance with project requirements, drawings, specifications, and method statements. Prepare power system studies and support the design, testing, commissioning, and integration of AC and DC electrified railway power systems. Perform site investigations, technical analyses, troubleshooting, and design reviews. Develop engineering documentation, including design packages, as-built drawings, and O&M manuals. Define interfaces between power systems and other infrastructure systems, coordinating with stakeholders, vendors, and multidisciplinary project teams. Support the development, testing, evaluation, and optimization of substations, power distribution systems, protection systems, and power conversion equipment. Required Qualifications and Experience Over 10 years of proven experience in the design and implementation of HV and LV railway power systems, including AC/DC traction power systems, substations, transformers, switchgear, circuit breakers, rectifiers, and power distribution networks. Strong knowledge of railway power system standards, electrified railway substations, SCADA and PLC protection systems, stray current mitigation, and wayside cable systems. Demonstrated ability to perform technical studies, engineering analyses, testing, troubleshooting, and stakeholder-driven design reviews. Experience with power electronic control and protection systems. Understanding of multi-modular converter technologies and advanced traction power applications. Familiarity with overhead catenary systems and third-rail traction power systems. Skills and Attributes Strong communication and collaboration skills, essential for working in multidisciplinary engineering environments. Ability to work effectively within a team and coordinate with various stakeholders. Location This position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

cb0068516721180e.description: Overview of the Role Qiddiya | القدية is seeking a Senior Manager Incident Management to lead incident and crisis management for the City Command Unit (CCU) in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves developing, maintaining, and assuring the framework for classifying, escalating, commanding, and resolving incidents across Qiddiya City, from initial report to Gold-level crisis activation. The Senior Manager will act as the CCU's senior incident lead during major incidents and crises, ensuring consistent response across all assets, venues, and partners. Key Responsibilities Lead the incident management function within the Crisis Operations sub-department of the City Command Unit, providing professional direction on incident handling. Develop and maintain the incident management framework, including classification, escalation matrix, notification cascades, and command roles, in alignment with the Joint Security Operating Model, Emergency Response Plan, and Incident Command System principles. Act as the CCU's senior incident lead at the tactical (Silver) level during major incidents and crisis activations, establishing command, setting priorities, coordinating response, and briefing leadership. Assure live incident handling in the control room, supporting shift managers and ensuring accurate record-keeping, common operating picture, and timely escalation. Manage the CCU's crisis management arrangements, including the crisis management room, support to the Gold-level crisis team, and information management, to ensure controlled transitions from incident to crisis. Coordinate multi-agency incident response interfaces with various internal and external authorities, ensuring clear roles, primacy, and handover procedures. Lead the post-incident process, including debriefs, structured reviews, root-cause analysis, and maintaining a lessons learned and corrective-action register. Analyze incident data and trends, define performance indicators, and report performance and emerging risks to leadership. Build incident-command competence across the CCU and its partners through designing and delivering training, coaching, and assessment. Ensure incident response procedures, action cards, and scenario playbooks are current, usable, and aligned with emergency plans and exercise programs. Required Experience and Skills A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in incident and crisis management. Demonstrated ability to develop, implement, and assure incident management frameworks. Experience in leading incident response at tactical and strategic levels. Proficiency in coordinating multi-agency responses and managing stakeholder interfaces. Strong analytical skills for incident data, trend analysis, and performance reporting. Capability to design and deliver training programs in incident command and decision-making. Work Environment This role is based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and operates on a full-time basis within the City Command Unit of Qiddiya. The position requires active engagement in a dynamic environment focused on ensuring the safety and operational continuity of Qiddiya City.

cb5095f1b874f749.description: About the Role Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking a Senior Manager - Utilities Commercialization to join their team. This full-time role involves assisting the Senior Director in strategic assessment, business case compilation, and supporting decision-making for commercialization assessments and implementation of utilities and infrastructure projects. The position requires 8-12 years of relevant experience. Role Context and Objectives The Senior Manager will focus on project finance, valuation modeling, and scenario analysis. Key responsibilities include building, maintaining, and reviewing robust financial models for utilities and infrastructure projects to support commercialization efforts and strategic decision-making within the company. Key Responsibilities Develop comprehensive financial models covering demand, revenues, tariff escalation, CAPEX, OPEX, lifecycle costs, financing, tax, working capital, and returns. Construct project finance structures, including debt sizing, repayment sculpting, debt service reserve accounts, DSCR/LLCR analysis, covenants, and shareholder distributions. Prepare valuation models using methodologies such as DCF, NPV, IRR, payback, comparable benchmarks, and scenario-based valuation outputs. Conduct sensitivities and stress tests to evaluate project robustness, affordability, funding gaps, bankability, and downside risk. Maintain model governance standards, including version control, audit trails, change logs, assumptions registers, and quality checks. Translate complex model outputs into clear dashboards, charts, decision papers, and presentations for DFA management and senior stakeholders. Required Skills and Attributes Demonstrated high attention to detail. Strong communication skills, with the ability to work effectively under deadlines. Confidence in challenging assumptions with stakeholders. Proficiency in project management and stakeholder management. Ability to synthesize technical and financial inputs into actionable insights. Strong problem-solving capabilities. Experience Requirements Candidates should possess 8-12 years of experience relevant to the responsibilities outlined for this role. Application Process Qiddiya Investment Company invites qualified candidates to apply for this position.

cbcca9277b82f8b0.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة اسياف التطوير للمقاولات عن مهندس ميكانيكي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات لمشاريع الهندسة الميكانيكية، بالإضافة إلى تطوير برامج التجميع والتركيب والتشغيل والصيانة للمعدات الصناعية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. الهدف من الوظيفة يهدف شاغل هذه الوظيفة إلى ضمان كفاءة وفعالية الأنظمة الميكانيكية في المشاريع الصناعية من خلال إعداد تصاميم دقيقة، ووضع خطط تشغيل وصيانة وقائية، وتوثيق جميع الأعمال والتقارير المتعلقة بالتقدم المحرز. يشمل ذلك متابعة تنفيذ البرامج وتطوير أساليب العمل لمواكبة التطورات التقنية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الهندسية لمشاريع الأعمال الميكانيكية، بما في ذلك المولدات، التوربينات، وحدات التكييف، المراجل، وشبكات توزيع أنظمة التدفئة والتكييف والتبريد. تطوير خطط وبرامج تجميع وتركيب التجهيزات الميكانيكية للمشاريع الصناعية، وتحديد أنظمة الضبط والتحكم اللازمة. إعداد برامج تشغيل المعدات وبرامج الصيانة الوقائية وفقاً لتعليمات الشركات المصنعة، ومتابعة إجراءات تنفيذها بفعالية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل بشكل مستمر ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في مجال الهندسة الميكانيكية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب تقدمها، وعرضها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات شهادة جامعية في الهندسة الميكانيكية أو مجال ذي صلة. خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الهندسة الميكانيكية، ويفضل أن تكون في مشاريع المقاولات أو الصناعة. معرفة قوية بمبادئ التصميم الميكانيكي وأنظمة التدفئة والتكييف والتبريد. القدرة على إعداد المخططات والوثائق الفنية بدقة. بيئة العمل يعمل المهندس الميكانيكي ضمن فريق عمل في مدينة الرياض، في بيئة عمل ديناميكية تتطلب الالتزام بالمهام المحددة والتعاون مع الزملاء لضمان سير المشاريع بسلاسة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف.

cbe6460e99d27d55.description: About the Role Larsen & Toubro is seeking a Design Lead - Primary PSS (Electrical) to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role requires over 10 years of experience and involves leading primary engineering activities for AIS/GIS Substation Projects across various geographical domains. The Design Lead will be responsible for reviewing and executing engineering tasks, facilitating BIM 3D model development, and coordinating with multiple departments to ensure project success. Key Responsibilities Ensure timely delivery of engineering drawings and documents. Review engineering documents from the Remote Engineering office (India) and coordinate local adaptation for language translation and compliance. Coordinate with local contractors to support construction work and resolve issues. Liaise with ACWA and NEGU teams for drawing approval for construction activities. Align all deliveries with the project schedule. Obtain spatial requirements and details of cut-outs/openings from the Design Lead (Secondary) and integrate them into relevant drawings. Review primary drawings, design, and sizing calculations for electrical equipment, and secure client approvals. Review vendor deliverables related to Primary Engineering. Manage multiple tasks and deliver them on time. Coordinate with various disciplines to ensure inter-departmental checks. Provide support and clarifications to the Site Execution team. Check pre-award vendor evaluations against client technical specifications and forward validation documents to Supply Chain Management. Inspect equipment from finalized vendors after validation document submission. Clarify design and client requirement issues to the Site Execution Team. Collect project details (plot details, feeder arrangements) from the client and Project Engineering Manager. Coordinate with the Operations team and communicate design specifications for approval. Collect inputs for project details (General Arrangement Drawings) from Vendors. Check deliverables from the Engineering office for construction suitability, including Equipment layouts, Cable Routing, Cable Tray, Earthing, Lighting, and Lightning Protection layouts. Support the secondary team in reviewing Vendor drawings. Submit man-hour requirements for undertaking and reviewing project design and drawings. Required Qualifications and Experience Over 10 years of experience in relevant engineering roles. Comprehensive knowledge of equipment layouts and necessary calculations. Detailed knowledge of Substation equipment and their layouts. Understanding of primary engineering activities including SLD Preparation, Layout Engineering, Earthing, Cable Routing, Lighting, Lightning Protection, and Cable Tray Routing. Proficiency in performing design and sizing calculations for Busbar, UPS, DG, LT Transformer, Earthing Conductor, and calculations such as Short circuit force, Sag tension, and CCC. Knowledge of National and International Codes and Standards. Ability to understand and interpret contractual technical requirements and support Project Teams as needed. Overall understanding of inter-disciplinary design aspects (Civil & Structural, Mechanical, and Instrumentation) related to electrical equipment. cb00d5d38fedb768.description: About the Role Siemens is seeking a Head of Customer Services for Electrification and Automation to lead the field service business across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The position reports to regional Customer Services leadership and plays a key role in advancing digitalization initiatives and scaling service capabilities. Drive operational excellence across field service teams by optimizing productivity, workforce utilization, and service delivery outcomes. Develop and execute service strategies that support business growth, portfolio expansion, and long-term market competitiveness. Lead a multi-layered, cross-functional organization spanning service operations, sales, training, and technical teams across Saudi Arabia. Partner with product management, operations, and strategy teams to align service initiatives with broader business objectives and innovation efforts. Advance digitalization and business transformation initiatives to modernize service delivery and improve customer outcomes. Build workforce capability through training, safety programs, and long-term talent development. Proven ability to lead multi-layered, cross-functional organizations. Experience serving critical infrastructure customers across Utilities, Process Industries, and Infrastructure Markets. Strong understanding of digitalization initiatives and business transformation. Qualified Saudi national engineering professionals meeting the stated qualifications are strongly encouraged to apply. Siemens is dedicated to developing local talent and building long-term engineering capability within the Kingdom. Siemens is an equal opportunities employer committed to quality, equality, and valuing diversity, providing access, equal opportunity, and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities.

cb803bf32c4071ef.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الرويس عن مهندس مدني للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل الوظيفة مسؤولية إدارة وتنسيق جميع الأنشطة الميدانية والتشغيلية في مواقع المشاريع لضمان تنفيذ أعمال التشييد والتطوير وفقًا للمخططات والمواصفات المعتمدة. يهدف الدور إلى تحقيق معايير الجودة والاستدامة والسلامة المهنية ضمن الجدول الزمني والميزانية المحددة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية قيادة وتوجيه فرق العمل الميدانية، بما في ذلك المهندسون والمشرفون والفنيون والعمالة والمقاولون من الباطن، لضمان انسيابية العمل واستمرارية التشغيل في مواقع المشاريع. مراقبة تقدم الأعمال ومقارنتها بالرسومات الهندسية والمواصفات الفنية والجدول الزمني المعتمد، ومعالجة أي تأخيرات أو عقبات ميدانية بشكل فوري واستباقي. تنسيق وتنظيم استخدام المواد وقطع الغيار والمستلزمات التشغيلية والمعدات والآليات في الموقع مع الإدارات المختصة لضمان الجاهزية وتقليل الهدر. ضمان التطبيق الصارم لاشتراطات الجودة ومعايير الصحة والسلامة المهنية والتصاريح الأمنية والتشغيلية، خاصة في المواقع الحكومية والمنشآت الحيوية. التواصل والتنسيق المستمر مع الاستشاريين وممثلي الجهات المالكة/الحكومية والموردين، ومتابعة الملاحظات والموافقات الفنية لضمان عدم تعطل الأعمال. إعداد ورفع التقارير اليومية والأسبوعية عن نسب الإنجاز وحالة الموقع والموارد وأي مخاطر أو تحديات ميدانية إلى إدارة المشاريع. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 5 إلى 10 سنوات في مجال الهندسة المدنية وإدارة المشاريع. فهم عميق للمخططات الهندسية والمواصفات الفنية ومعايير الجودة والسلامة المهنية. القدرة على قيادة وتوجيه فرق العمل الميدانية والمقاولين. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات ممتازة في التخطيط والتنظيم وإدارة الوقت. القدرة على حل المشكلات واتخاذ القرارات السريعة في بيئة العمل الميدانية. مهارات تواصل وتنسيق قوية مع مختلف الأطراف المعنية بالمشروع. القدرة على إعداد التقارير الفنية والإدارية بوضوح ودقة. بيئة العمل تتطلب الوظيفة العمل بدوام كامل في مدينة الرياض، مع التركيز على الإدارة الميدانية والتشغيلية في مواقع المشاريع المختلفة. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

cb8d7fcf93f00f39.description: About the Role Proger *** is seeking a Document Controller to join its team in Riyadh, Riyadh. Experience: A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in document control. Work Environment This role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and operates on a full-time schedule. The Document Controller will work within a project team, ensuring the integrity and accessibility of project documentation.

Identify, qualify, and advance new business opportunities through direct customer engagement, channel partners, engineering contractors, and strategic accounts. Support product approvals, approved vendor list expansion, supplier development initiatives, and market pricing strategies. Support sales teams and channel partners throughout the sales cycle, from opportunity identification through order closure. Provide technical and commercial guidance during solution development, proposal preparation, and customer discussions. Promote effective use of CRM, business intelligence, and forecasting tools to improve sales effectiveness and pipeline visibility. Maintain accurate opportunity pipelines, forecasts, and business performance reporting. Ensure compliance with applicable trade regulations, company policies, and environmental, health, and safety requirements. Candidate Profile The ideal candidate consistently identifies and pursues opportunities that create value for customers and the business. This role requires building partnerships and collaborating with others to achieve shared objectives, fostering trust and strong working relationships. The successful candidate will adapt their approach and remain effective in changing environments, balancing strategic thinking with practical execution to deliver results. Active engagement with diverse perspectives, encouragement of innovation, and the ability to translate customer and market insights into actions that advance business growth and long-term success are essential. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of experience in Business Development, specifically within Pressure & Temperature. Demonstrated ability to drive business growth and achieve strategic objectives. Experience in developing and executing growth strategies for project business, MRO, long-term partnership agreements, and new product introductions. Proficiency in identifying and advancing new business opportunities through various channels. Strong collaboration skills with cross-functional teams and external partners. About Emerson Emerson is a global leader in automation technology and software, providing solutions to critical industries such as life sciences, energy, power and renewables, chemical, and advanced factory automation. The company focuses on helping customers operate more sustainably while improving productivity, energy security, and reliability. Emerson has global operations and a comprehensive portfolio of software and technology, supporting digital transformation to improve operations, conserve resources, and enhance safety. Emerson is committed to equitable opportunities, diversity, and making a positive impact across various countries and industries.

cbba29dfdfe138ad.description: About GEP GEP is seeking a Sourcing Lead to join its Knowledge Services team. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Riyad Ar Rimah, Al Qasim, and involves executing complex and strategic sourcing projects across various categories. The role requires 5-10 years of experience in strategic sourcing. Role Overview As a Sourcing Lead, you will be responsible for translating business needs into clear Statements of Work (SOW), managing bids, leading auctions, and collaborating with suppliers and internal stakeholders to achieve optimal sourcing outcomes. This position is suited for professionals with a strong background in supply chain and project management. Key Responsibilities Lead complex and strategic sourcing projects across various categories and sub-categories by translating business requirements into clear, actionable Statements of Work. Manage the end-to-end bidding process, including soliciting bids, preparing negotiation scripts (*, RFI, RFP, RFQ, Scorecard and Bid Analysis), leading auctions, and providing supplier recommendations. Negotiate with suppliers to secure optimal terms, onboard and qualify new vendors, and ensure full compliance with contractual and organizational standards. Serve as a thought leader, applying business expertise to assist clients in achieving long-term strategic goals. Optimize functional sourcing support activities while ensuring alignment with client corporate standards and providing necessary information to the enablement group. Collaborate with internal and external business partners to drive decisions aligned with organizational goals and ensure efficient daily execution. Manage project allocation, support team members during kick-off meetings, and share best practices to foster continuous improvement across sourcing activities. Monitor performance satisfaction, ensure Service Level Agreements (SLAs) are met, and lead continuous improvement initiatives for sourcing processes. Participate in recruitment and team-building efforts to strengthen the Knowledge Services team. Qualifications and Requirements Minimum of 5 years of proven experience in strategic sourcing, with a focus on direct or indirect categories. Experience in indirect categories such as IT, HR, Professional services, Marketing, Logistics, and Business services is beneficial. Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to engage and influence stakeholders at all levels within client organizations. Highly analytical mindset, capable of developing baselines, conducting market analysis, and presenting findings concisely and effectively. Demonstrated success in leading and executing complex negotiations. Ability to manage multiple procurement projects simultaneously, assess new purchase requirements, and manage spend and risk. Familiarity with business process improvement methodologies such as TQM, Six Sigma, or APEX is advantageous. What GEP Offers Opportunities for professional development and growth within a global organization. A dynamic and collaborative work environment.

cbdff5ff8d08aea0.description: About Ingredion Ingredion is a global company that utilizes natural ingredients across more than 60 industries. The company's work is present in various products, from food items to paper. Ingredion values diverse perspectives and aims to make a positive impact through its products. Role Overview The Market Development Representative for Saudi Arabia acts as Ingredion's primary market presence in the region. This full-time role involves market screening, building customer and industry relationships, and identifying growth opportunities. The representative will collaborate with the Ingredion Sales Team to convert market knowledge into a qualified pipeline and support segment strategies. This position reports to the Area Sales Manager – Middle East. Key Responsibilities Support business growth within the assigned segment and region by identifying market opportunities, developing insight-led recommendations, and generating leads for the Ingredion Sales Team. Conduct structured market analysis to understand customer needs, competitor activities, emerging trends, and growth potential across Saudi Arabia, sharing insights for account planning and opportunity development. Identify, qualify, and develop new leads within target markets and customer segments, building a prospect pipeline by researching potential customers and mapping decision-makers for the Sales Team. Initiate and support customer outreach, including introductory conversations, needs discovery, follow-up communications, and coordination of customer meetings, in close alignment with the Ingredion Sales Team. Build and expand networks among customers, industry contacts, retailers, food service providers, and other market stakeholders, representing Ingredion professionally and enhancing brand awareness. Collaborate with the Ingredion Sales Team by preparing market information, customer background, meeting inputs, and opportunity updates, coordinating input from Marketing, Technical Service, Customer Service, Supply Chain, and Finance to advance qualified leads and customer projects. Maintain accurate records of customer outreach, leads, opportunities, and market activity in company systems, including Salesforce, and adhere to company Sales Excellence standards while staying current on market intelligence and the food ingredients sector. Benefits Ingredion offers a range of rewards and benefits designed to support career advancement and employee well-being. Disability Inclusion Ingredion provides support to applicants with disabilities throughout the recruitment process. Accommodations will be made for applicants requiring assistance during the application or selection stages.

cb121c5835f61323.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة صلب تهامة لمنتجات الحديد عن أخصائي مشتريات للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تقييم احتياجات المواد، ومسح السوق للحصول على أفضل الأسعار، والإشراف على عروض الموردين، وبناء قواعد بيانات للموردين والأسعار. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تقييم احتياجات ومتطلبات الوحدات التنظيمية المختلفة من المواد وتحديد أولويات الشراء بناءً على ذلك. إجراء الدراسات والتحليلات المتخصصة ومسح السوق للوصول إلى أفضل أسعار الشراء من الموردين ولضمان الجودة المطلوبة للمواد وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. الإشراف على عمليات وإجراءات استلام العروض من موردي الخدمات وتقييمها بالتنسيق مع الوحدات الإدارية الأخرى، وضمان مطابقتها للإجراءات المعتمدة. بناء قاعدة بيانات لأسعار المواد المستهلكة بصورة متكررة وأهم الموردين لها، والاحتفاظ بملفات متكاملة عن عمليات الشراء المختلفة وفقاً للنظام المعتمد. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالمبيعات، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وتوضيحها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المشتريات أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تقييم الاحتياجات وتحديد أولويات الشراء. مهارات تحليلية قوية لمسح السوق وتقييم العروض. القدرة على بناء وإدارة قواعد البيانات. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تواصل ممتازة للتنسيق مع الموردين والوحدات الداخلية. القدرة على إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة. الالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة صلب تهامة لمنتجات الحديد في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريقنا، يرجى التقديم لهذه الفرصة في مجال المشتريات.

cb13b83d003b401d.description: About the Role TAWANTECH is seeking a Senior Data Scientist to join their team. This full-time role focuses on transforming complex business and operational data into actionable insights and advanced analytical solutions. The Senior Data Scientist will be responsible for developing statistical models, machine learning models, predictive analytics, and data-driven solutions to support business decision-making and strategic initiatives. Key Responsibilities Analyze large and complex datasets to identify trends, patterns, and business opportunities. Develop and deploy statistical, predictive, and machine learning models. Perform data cleaning, preprocessing, feature engineering, and exploratory data analysis. Select appropriate algorithms and optimize model performance. Evaluate models using appropriate statistical and machine learning metrics. Translate business requirements into data science and analytical solutions. Build forecasting, classification, regression, clustering, and optimization models. Collaborate with Data Engineers, AI Engineers, Business Analysts, and business stakeholders. Develop dashboards, reports, and visualizations to communicate analytical findings. Deploy and monitor models in production environments. Ensure data quality, reproducibility, scalability, and appropriate model documentation. Support advanced analytics, AI initiatives, and continuous improvement of existing models. Experience Required Candidates for this Senior Data Scientist position should have 0-1 years of relevant experience. Work Type This is a full-time position.

cb15e5087dbdded0.job_title: Senior Director Roads and Mobility AG
cb15e5087dbdded0.description: About Qiddiya Investment Company Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking a Senior Director – Roads and Mobility to lead the strategy, operational governance, and lifecycle performance of Qiddiya City’s roads, bridges, tunnels, and associated infrastructure, including Intelligent Transport Systems (ITS). This is a full-time position requiring over 10 years of experience. Role Overview As the accountable asset owner, the Senior Director will establish the standards, operating model, and investment priorities necessary to deliver a safe, reliable, and resilient road network. The role involves close collaboration with development teams, transport operators, and relevant authorities to oversee operational readiness, maintenance, and service-provider performance. This support is critical for everyday city operations, phased openings, and major events. Key Responsibilities Define and deliver the roads and mobility asset strategy, operating model, and long-term plans. Lead lifecycle management, inspection, maintenance, and renewal planning for roads, bridges, tunnels, and associated infrastructure. Set the ITS strategy, overseeing system availability, network monitoring, and integration with city command-and-control platforms. Lead asset-owner input into design, commissioning, and handover processes, ensuring maintainability and operational readiness. Oversee budgets, procurement requirements, and service providers, focusing on safety, quality, performance, and value. Coordinate network operating plans, roadworks, closures, and incident-response arrangements with authorities and operational stakeholders. Lead multidisciplinary teams and establish performance reporting covering asset condition, network availability, risks, and investment priorities. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Transportation Engineering, or a related engineering discipline. A relevant master’s degree is preferred. Typically 15+ years of relevant experience in roads, transport infrastructure, or network asset management. At least 5 years in senior leadership, accountable for significant asset portfolios, budgets, and multidisciplinary teams. Demonstrated asset-owner or client-side leadership across road networks, bridges, and tunnels, including maintenance and renewal programs. Strong experience in ITS oversight, operational handover, outsourced service delivery, and coordination with authorities and transport operators. Strong capability in risk-based asset management, lifecycle investment, and stakeholder leadership. Professional registration and major-event or regional experience are advantageous. Application Process Candidates who meet the specified requirements are encouraged to apply for this role.

cb2463ad94d18889.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة المجال جي 4 اس عن فني تبريد وتكييف للانضمام إلى فريقها. يركز هذا الدور على ضمان كفاءة عمل أنظمة التكييف والتبريد من خلال تنفيذ مهام التركيب والصيانة والإصلاح. هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل، براتب إجمالي قدره 5,400 ريال سعودي شامل البدلات، ومتاحة في مدن جدة، مكة المكرمة، ينبع، القصيم، الرياض، والدمام. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تركيب أنظمة التكييف والتبريد المختلفة وفقًا للمواصفات الفنية. إجراء الصيانة الدورية والوقائية للأجهزة والأنظمة لضمان استمرارية عملها. تشخيص الأعطال الفنية في أنظمة التبريد والتكييف وإصلاحها بفعالية. التأكد من كفاءة عمل الأجهزة والأنظمة بعد التركيب أو الصيانة. التعامل مع أي مشكلات فنية طارئة ومعالجتها في الوقت المناسب. المؤهلات والمتطلبات الحصول على دبلوم أو شهادة فنية في تخصص التبريد والتكييف أو تخصص ذي صلة. الخبرة المطلوبة: 0-1 سنة. حديثو التخرج مرحب بهم للتقدم لهذا الدور. تعتبر الخبرة من سنة إلى سنتين في مجال التبريد والتكييف ميزة إضافية. نطاق العمل هذا الدور متاح في عدة مدن بالمملكة العربية السعودية، بما في ذلك جدة، مكة المكرمة، ينبع، القصيم، الرياض، والدمام. يتطلب الدور العمل بدوام كامل لضمان تغطية جميع المهام والمسؤوليات المتعلقة بأنظمة التبريد والتكييف. الراتب الراتب الإجمالي لهذا المنصب هو 5,400 ريال سعودي، ويشمل هذا المبلغ جميع البدلات.

cb401925a933bcb1.description: About the Role Abdul Latif Jameel is seeking a Regional WSO Customer Specialist to join their team in Makkah, with locations in Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time role requires 2-5 years of experience and focuses on generating timely reports and monitoring key performance indicators to support management decision-making. Purpose of the Position The primary purpose of this role is to create comprehensive KPI reports, including data, graphics, charts, pivot tables, and maps. These reports provide essential information on network structure, distribution activities, commercial performance, and expansion planning. The specialist will also be responsible for monitoring and publishing these reports on a monthly, quarterly, half-yearly, or yearly basis to facilitate informed management decisions. Key Accountabilities Service NPS Score PSFU Service PRIDA Major Activities and Responsibilities Analyze and comment on Net Promoter Studies, ensuring coordination among stakeholders for efficient information flow. Escalate common issues to the department head. Perform data analysis from multiple sources and recommend best practices based on results. Generate regular service NPS and Post Service Follow-up reports. Monitor and report Network Performance to relevant stakeholders, focusing on guest recommendation KPIs. Observe the daily NPS dashboard. Follow up and report on NPS Task Force Committee action plans and outcomes. Retrieve specific VOG/NPS records from Qualtrics for managerial review and deletion if parameters are not met. Extract VOG/NPS data and create reports for uploading into Business Objects. Engage in NPS communication with all regional centers to ensure 100% customer satisfaction in Guest Experience, including implementation of the escalation process. Provide feedback to the NPS SGM regarding any negative trends to foster continuous improvement. Facilitate conversations between various centers to develop creative solutions and achieve ALJR's mission. Communicate with the ALJD GED team for further action. Respond to business and management inquiries related to the Net Promoter System and philosophy within the ALJ Network. Support dialogue with Senior Management and stakeholders regarding recommendation level monitoring and reporting. Participate in Kaizen Idea Campaigns to improve NPS. Collaborate with centers to identify NPS results and areas of weakness, actively proposing recommendations for improvement and implementing escalation processes. Support the maintenance of a current and comprehensive database of guest feedback raw data, data visualization, and other technical aspects, publishing data nationally to standardize details. Perform other tasks, duties, and assignments as required by leadership. Experience Required Candidates should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience in a similar role, demonstrating proficiency in data analysis, reporting, and stakeholder coordination. Work Type and Location This is a full-time position based in the Makkah region, with work locations in Jeddah and Makkah.

cb46f52f2c9cddcd.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ابو دقن لحفر الابار عن مشغل آلة درفلة معادن للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية تشغيل آلات درفلة المعادن لثني أو نشر المنتجات المعدنية، مع ضمان جودة وسلامة الإنتاج. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تشغيل آلات بثق المعادن والتحقق من مطابقة المنتج للمواصفات الفنية. القيام بعمليات تفتيش روتينية للصيانة الوقائية للكشف عن الأضرار والتلفيات في الأجزاء. تحديد المشاكل واتخاذ الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة. تنظيف المعدات وإجراء الصيانة الأساسية. الإبلاغ عن الأعطال لفنيي الصيانة أو الميكانيكيين. الاحتفاظ بسجل للأعمال المنجزة. اتباع سياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في تشغيل آلات درفلة المعادن أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على قراءة وفهم المواصفات الفنية للمنتجات المعدنية. معرفة جيدة بإجراءات الصيانة الأساسية للمعدات. المهارات والكفاءات الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل لضمان جودة المنتج. القدرة على تحديد المشاكل الفنية واتخاذ الإجراءات التصحيحية. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة. مهارات التواصل الفعال للإبلاغ عن الأعطال والاحتفاظ بالسجلات. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية، وهو دور بدوام كامل ضمن فريق عمل متخصص في شركة ابو دقن لحفر الابار. الراتب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

cb596334fba4650c.job_title: Assistant Director of Finance 'Saudi National Only'
cb596334fba4650c.description: About the Role The Luxury Collection is seeking an Assistant Director of Finance to manage the day-to-day operations of the Accounting Office. This full-time position is based in Jeddah, Makkah, and is open exclusively to Saudi Nationals. The role involves primary responsibilities in financial analysis, reporting, budgeting, audit and control, and reconciliation of assets and liabilities. Key Responsibilities Oversee internal, external, and regulatory audit processes. Ensure regular communication with employees regarding business objectives and performance expectations. Establish and maintain collaborative relationships within the team. Participate in employee performance appraisals and ensure fair administration of property policies. Generate accurate and timely financial reports and presentations. Analyze financial information to identify solutions and resolve problems. Ensure the accuracy of the Profit & Loss statement and timely delivery to relevant individuals. Reconcile balance sheets and ensure compliance with standard and local operating procedures (SOPs and LSOPs). Review audit issues and implement necessary corrections. Leverage centralized accounting processes and shared services. Financial Management and Guidance Inform executives, peers, and subordinates on relevant financial information in a timely manner. Advise the Director of Finance on existing and evolving operating and financial issues. Communicate financial concepts clearly to drive desired behaviors. Provide direction and assistance to other organizational units regarding accounting and budgeting policies. Ensure timely submission of reports and accurate documentation of profits and losses. Monitor all applicable taxes, ensuring they are current, collected, and/or accrued. Support a strong accounting and operational control environment to safeguard assets and improve profitability. Required Skills and Qualifications Demonstrated knowledge of job-relevant financial issues, products, systems, and processes. Proficiency in using computers and financial software for data entry and report generation. Ability to apply new technical knowledge to job functions. Strong interpersonal and communication skills to lead and influence others. Experience: 0-1 years in a relevant financial or accounting role. Must be a Saudi National. Work Environment This is a full-time position within The Luxury Collection, based in Jeddah, Makkah. The role requires collaboration with various teams and adherence to established financial policies and procedures. Application Process Candidates meeting the qualifications are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

cb78b6457e46e5c1.description: About the Role SNC-Lavalin Fayez Engineering is seeking a Document Control Assistant to support document management and control functions for a major infrastructure and landscape development project in Riyadh. This full-time role involves working on behalf of the Project Management Consultant (PMC) to ensure all project documentation is accurately managed throughout the project lifecycle. Role Context and Objectives The Document Control Assistant will be responsible for ensuring that all project documentation, including correspondence, drawings, reports, technical submissions, and records, are accurately received, tracked, distributed, stored, and maintained. This must be done in accordance with project requirements, quality standards, contractual obligations, and established document control procedures. The role requires close collaboration with the client, consultants, contractors, and project teams to maintain document integrity, support compliance with project governance processes, and facilitate efficient information flow. Key Responsibilities Lead and manage document control activities for project documentation from design through construction, commissioning, and project handover. Review, register, track, distribute, and maintain project correspondence, drawings, reports, transmittals, and technical documentation. Ensure all project documents comply with established document control procedures, project requirements, and quality management standards. Monitor document workflows to ensure timely processing, review, approval, and distribution of submissions. Maintain accurate document registers, filing systems, databases, and electronic document management systems (EDMS). Coordinate document interfaces among clients, consultants, contractors, vendors, and project stakeholders. Conduct regular audits of project records and document control systems to ensure accuracy, completeness, and compliance. Monitor document-related risks and proactively support mitigation measures to minimize impacts on project delivery. Facilitate document coordination activities and support communication between project teams and stakeholders. Review and process incoming and outgoing correspondence, technical submissions, RFIs, shop drawings, reports, and contractual documentation. Track document control KPIs, submission logs, document status reports, and performance metrics for management review. Ensure proper archiving, retrieval, retention, and handover of project records and documentation. Support procurement and commercial teams by maintaining document records related to vendor submissions and contract documentation. Drive resolution of document management issues affecting project delivery and stakeholder communication. Ensure compliance with health, safety, environmental, quality, and project governance requirements related to document management. Support, coordinate, and collaborate with project teams to ensure effective document control practices across all project disciplines. Experience and Qualifications Candidates should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience in document control, preferably within large-scale infrastructure or development projects. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, working within a project management consultant team on a significant infrastructure and landscape development project.

cb915b8d4690e290.description: About Qiddiya Investment Company Qiddiya Investment Company is developing a landmark destination in the Kingdom, focused on redefining entertainment, culture, and hospitality. The Hospitality Business Unit is responsible for developing a portfolio of hotel assets central to this vision. The company seeks experienced professionals to ensure these assets meet high standards of design quality, guest experience, and commercial performance. Role Overview As the Senior Director - Architecture - Hospitality, you will lead the architectural design agenda across the hospitality portfolio. This full-time role involves defining design principles and shaping hotel concepts from the initial development brief through to endorsed design direction. You will also oversee consultants and ensure design integrity, technical compliance, and performance are maintained throughout the delivery process. Key Responsibilities Lead the architectural definition of hotel concepts from development brief to approved design direction, ensuring alignment with Qiddiya, district, and Operator visions. Articulate architectural design proposals to secure alignment and timely outcomes through key governance stages. Define architectural design principles, typologies, and performance benchmarks for each hotel tier, establishing consistent design baselines. Oversee consultant briefing and scope definition, validating architectural scope and specialist inputs to align with development briefs, asset positioning, Operator requirements, and governance approvals. Oversee visualization and design communication, including CGI strategy, to ensure concepts are clearly articulated and aligned with design narratives and stakeholder expectations. Lead and govern architecture and specialist consultants, driving strategic approaches on appointment, scope, and deliverables, and overseeing performance, quality, and creative alignment. Provide functional governance to project-embedded design management teams, reviewing and endorsing architectural deliverables to maintain approved design intent through delivery. Lead technical input to development briefs, shaping planning efficiency, gross-to-net ratios, spatial configuration, and system integration for hospitality assets. Drive integrated coordination across architecture, interiors, landscape, and technical disciplines, resolving interfaces and ensuring cohesive design outcomes. Lead structured review of design submissions across key milestones, providing clear feedback and endorsement to support design progression. Provide creative and technical design oversight through design and construction, resolving interfaces and deviations to maintain design quality and intent. Guide value engineering and design optimization, balancing design intent, guest experience, and asset performance. Champion sustainability and climate-responsive design, embedding ESG and Vision 2030 priorities. Mentor teams and drive continuous improvement of design processes, standards, and best practices. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in architecture, specifically within the hospitality sector. Demonstrated ability to lead creative architectural design agendas and define design principles for hotel concepts. Experience in overseeing consultants and ensuring design integrity, technical compliance, and performance. Strong understanding of design quality, guest experience, and commercial performance in hospitality assets. Work Type This is a full-time position within Qiddiya Investment Company.

cbb525f596bf1d91.description: About the Role Publicis Sapient is seeking a Product Management Director, Financial Services, to lead digital product delivery for clients. This full-time position is based in Riyadh and involves significant collaboration with digital product leadership to implement user-centric experiences. The role requires 5-10 years of experience and focuses on achieving product and business goals through partnerships across various disciplines, including experience design, data and analytics, marketing, and technology. Key Responsibilities Define and communicate digital product strategy to teams and partners, ensuring alignment with organizational goals. Translate strategic objectives into executable product roadmaps. Develop an understanding of the digital product's value to core users and identify key user journeys. Integrate domain roadmaps, such as Experience and Analytics, into the overall product roadmap. Gather and synthesize insights from quantitative data, qualitative data, user testing, and market research to inform data-driven product roadmaps. Formulate hypotheses and business cases based on data analysis. Oversee digital product performance against established goals and KPIs. Manage stakeholder expectations for intake requests and guide partners through the intake process. Lead decisions regarding product team ownership, structure, and cost. Manage a team of Digital Product Managers, communicating the overall vision, roadmap, and goals. Collaborate with product owners to integrate knowledge and data into feedback loops, influencing roadmap development. Work with portfolio and technology teams to ensure roadmap prioritization and timely delivery. Escalate roadmap impacts and issues to leadership and present solutions. Demonstrated track record of shipping digital products and a portfolio of user-centric digital experiences with positive impacts on engagement and KPIs. Significant industry knowledge and expertise within the Financial Services (Banking) sector. Experience building and leading digital product scrum teams. Experience working with multi-disciplinary teams including product managers, project managers/scrum masters, UI/UX, marketers, and engineering. Strong ability to process and interpret large datasets for decision-making. Proficiency in transforming complex inputs into a clear, communicable vision. Results-oriented individual with strong influencing, problem-solving, and negotiation skills. Ability to build and focus effective teams, demonstrating and demanding integrity. Outstanding communication and storytelling skills. Knowledge of current digital web and application standards. Valued Additional Experience Certified SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager designation. cb072cdcdcd4acf2.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الهوادج لتأجير السيارات عن أخصائي مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تطوير وتنفيذ سياسات واستراتيجيات المبيعات، ومتابعة الأداء، وتقديم التقارير المتخصصة لضمان تحقيق الأهداف البيعية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة وتحليل تطورات السوق لتحديد وتطوير الأهداف التسويقية وطرق البيع، وتقدير حجم المبيعات المتوقع، وتحويل الأهداف إلى خطط بيعية قابلة للتنفيذ. اقتراح سياسات البيع ومتابعة تنفيذها، بالإضافة إلى تقييم البرامج الترويجية الحالية والمقترحة. التواصل الفعال مع العملاء لتحديد احتياجاتهم ومشكلاتهم، ومتابعة المنافسين وبرامجهم البيعية لتجنب المخاطر المحتملة. تقييم أداء مندوبي المبيعات ومدى تحقيق الأهداف البيعية، واقتراح الخطط والإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالمبيعات، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المبيعات أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تحليل بيانات السوق وتحديد الفرص البيعية. مهارات تواصل ممتازة للتعامل مع العملاء والزملاء. بيئة العمل يعمل أخصائي المبيعات في بيئة عمل ديناميكية في مدينة الرياض، ضمن فريق يسعى لتحقيق الأهداف البيعية للشركة وتطوير استراتيجياتها. معلومات إضافية هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويقدم فرصة للمساهمة في نمو شركة الهوادج لتأجير السيارات. لم يتم الكشف عن تفاصيل الراتب في الوقت الحالي. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور في الرياض.

cb12943f148b6a37.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مجمع الفارس كلينك الطبي عن أخصائي تسويق للانضمام إلى فريقه في مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تطوير وتنفيذ وتقييم السياسات التسويقية للسلع والخدمات، بالإضافة إلى إجراء اختبارات السوق وإعداد التقارير المتخصصة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تحديد الأهداف التسويقية العامة والفرعية، وتطوير السياسات والخطط والبرامج التسويقية. تحليل دورة حياة المنتج وتحديد عوامل نجاح أو فشل تسويق المنتجات. تحليل أسعار المنافسين وتطوير سياسات التسعير التنافسية. تحديد برامج الترويج واختيار قنوات التوزيع وتقييم فعالية الحملات الإعلانية. وضع برنامج زمني لتنفيذ السياسات التسويقية ومتابعة إجراءات التنفيذ وتقييم النتائج المحققة. إجراء اختبارات للمنتجات الجديدة قبل طرحها في الأسواق باستخدام برامج حاسوبية متخصصة في اختبارات السوق، بما يتوافق مع متطلبات العمل. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالتسويق، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال التسويق. القدرة على تحديد الأهداف وتطوير السياسات التسويقية. مهارات تحليلية قوية لتقييم أداء المنتجات والسوق. القدرة على استخدام برامج حاسوبية متخصصة في اختبارات السوق. بيئة العمل سيعمل أخصائي التسويق ضمن فريق مجمع الفارس كلينك الطبي في مكة المكرمة، في بيئة عمل ديناميكية تتطلب الالتزام بالدوام الكامل. ملخص الوظيفة المسمى الوظيفي: أخصائي تسويق الشركة: مجمع الفارس كلينك الطبي الموقع: مكة المكرمة نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل الخبرة المطلوبة: 0-1 سنة التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريقنا، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم لهذه الفرصة في مكة المكرمة.

cb1adf68096a4efc.description: About Business Tribune Global Company Ltd Business Tribune Global Company Ltd (BTGC) operates as a specialized industrial supply and electro-mechanical equipment distributor, serving key industrial sectors across Saudi Arabia. Based in Dammam, the company extends its commercial operations throughout the Kingdom, providing technical solutions to high-demand industries. The Role of Indoor Sales Engineer – Global Sourcing BTGC is seeking a proactive and technically proficient Indoor Sales Engineer to join its team in Dammam. This full-time role is central to managing high-volume RFQs and supporting dedicated industrial divisions. The position involves bridging client technical requirements with global supply chains, acting as an internal driver for technical estimating, sourcing, and client fulfillment. The successful candidate will leverage their engineering background to evaluate supplier capabilities and secure optimal technical and commercial solutions. Key Responsibilities Review and process incoming client RFQs, translating complex technical requirements into accurate and competitive commercial proposals. Identify, evaluate, and source electro-mechanical equipment and industrial materials from global manufacturers. Conduct rigorous compliance checks on international trading partners, ensuring adherence to required standards such as verified tenure, third-party inspection audits (*, SGS/TÜV), and official commercial registrations. Navigate local supply networks and procurement standards, aligning global imports with specific localized project requirements and Aramco standards where applicable. Collaborate with estimating and technical teams to ensure proposed solutions meet the exact specifications of clients in heavy industry sectors. Maintain up-to-date knowledge of global commodity pricing, shipping logistics, and customs regulations to optimize margins and delivery timelines. Required Qualifications and Skills Candidates for this role should possess a strong technical background and demonstrated capability in sourcing directly from global vendors and international OEMs. A deep understanding of local purchasing protocols is also required. Application Process This full-time position is based in Dammam, Saudi Arabia. Qualified applicants are encouraged to apply.

cb1cffb52fa2c175.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة نخبة الأداء للتجارة عن أخصائي مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور على تطوير وتنفيذ سياسات واستراتيجيات المبيعات، ومتابعة الأداء، وتقديم التحليلات والتقارير اللازمة لضمان تحقيق الأهداف البيعية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال المبيعات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة ومتابعة تطورات السوق لتحديد وتطوير الأهداف التسويقية وطرق البيع. تقدير حجم المبيعات المتوقع وترجمة الأهداف إلى خطط بيعية قابلة للتنفيذ. اقتراح سياسات البيع ومتابعة تنفيذها وتقييم البرامج الترويجية. التواصل الفعال مع العملاء لتحديد مشكلاتهم وتقديم الحلول المناسبة. متابعة المنافسين وبرامجهم البيعية لتجنب المخاطر المحتملة. تقييم أداء مندوبي البيع ومدى تحقيق الأهداف البيعية، واقتراح الإجراءات التصحيحية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالمبيعات، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة. حفظ التقارير والوثائق في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال المبيعات. فهم عميق لسياسات واستراتيجيات البيع. القدرة على تحليل بيانات السوق وتحديد الفرص. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تواصل ممتازة، شفهية وكتابية. القدرة على بناء علاقات قوية مع العملاء. مهارات تحليلية قوية لتقييم الأداء واتخاذ القرارات. القدرة على العمل بشكل مستقل وكجزء من فريق. مهارات تنظيمية وإدارة الوقت. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. سيعمل أخصائي المبيعات ضمن فريق مبيعات ديناميكي يهدف إلى تحقيق النمو المستمر للشركة. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في نخبة الأداء للتجارة.

cb66f2009ce92602.description: About the Role Hilton is seeking an Executive Chef to oversee all culinary operations for its hotel in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The Executive Chef will be responsible for the overall success and profitability of the hotel's culinary functions. Key Responsibilities Direct culinary operations, including meal preparation and production, while maintaining high standards of food quality, presentation, and cost control. Collaborate with the Food and Beverage Director to develop new menus and individual menu items, incorporating current food trends and regional preferences. Engage with guests and clients to assess satisfaction, address feedback, and implement improvements to enhance the dining experience. Oversee budget management, forecasting, and financial reporting to ensure culinary operations meet financial targets and align with hotel goals. Optimize kitchen systems, processes, and workflows to ensure smooth and efficient operations. Cultivate a high-performing culinary team through performance management, professional development, and recognition programs. Ensure compliance with all health, safety, sanitation, and alcohol awareness regulations, promoting a culture committed to guest and team member wellbeing. About Hilton Hilton is a global hospitality leader recognized for its commitment to both guest experiences and team member development. cba59c998f2d0c10.description: About the Role Cornerstone Global Partners is collaborating with a major Saudi giga project to appoint a Senior Director, Operational Compliance & Monitoring (Fire and Life Safety). This full-time position is based in the Riyadh region. The role is integral to the newly established City Operations function, which oversees essential city services including fire and rescue, emergency response, operations, and maintenance. Role Purpose and Context This is a foundational role focused on establishing and leading the fire and life safety (FLS) operational compliance across the city. The Senior Director will ensure that operational assets, service providers, and emergency response arrangements consistently meet compliance standards, maintaining readiness and effectiveness as the city's assets become operational and occupied. Key Responsibilities Build and lead the operational FLS compliance and monitoring function. Establish an FLS compliance framework encompassing occupied assets, public spaces, facilities management, and the Fire and Rescue Service. Govern the contracted Fire and Rescue Service regarding readiness, response capability, staffing, training, equipment, and performance. Monitor facilities management delivery of fire system inspection, testing, maintenance, impairment control, and defect rectification. Develop risk-based inspection and audit programs, overseeing corrective actions through to verified closure. Define FLS KPIs and leading indicators, reporting gaps and emerging risks to senior leadership. Review incidents, system failures, and response performance to drive systemic improvement. Provide FLS input for events, asset changes, and occupancy decisions. Lead the operational FLS relationship with Civil Defense and other relevant authorities. Lead and develop the compliance team and specialist service providers. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in operational compliance and monitoring, specifically within fire and life safety. Demonstrated ability to establish compliance frameworks and lead functions in a developing environment. Experience in governing emergency services and monitoring facilities management for FLS adherence. To complete your application, please register on the Keystone AI platform, create your profile, upload your CV, and submit your application. An optional AI interview is available and encouraged. Commitment to Equal Opportunity CGP Group is an affirmative equal-opportunity employer and recruitment firm. Qualified applicants are evaluated without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, or any other protected class.

cba5b0f390e90d56.description: About the Role Dussmann Ajlan & Bros is seeking an Animal Care Consultant to oversee and manage existing Animal Care Contractors across various facilities in Saudi Arabia. This full-time role focuses on ensuring the consistent delivery of high-quality animal care services and compliance with animal welfare standards. Key Responsibilities Manage and supervise existing Animal Care Contractors to ensure high-quality service delivery. Oversee animal care operations in diverse settings including animal exhibits, VVIP animal farms, aquariums, and non-exotic farm animal facilities. Assess animal welfare, health, nutrition, behavior, and housing conditions to ensure compliance with applicable standards. Review existing animal care procedures and develop, implement, and update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). Develop animal care and husbandry management plans to maintain appropriate standards of animal health and welfare. Monitor and oversee veterinary health management, coordinating with veterinary professionals for appropriate medical care. Assess animal behavior and recommend appropriate animal handling, enrichment, and training programs. Monitor biosecurity measures, hygiene, disease prevention, and infection control procedures. Ensure proper animal records management, including health records, feeding schedules, veterinary treatments, vaccinations, and welfare assessments. Ensure compliance with Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA) requirements and other applicable regulations. Identify operational deficiencies, veterinary regulatory violations, and animal welfare non-compliances, recommending corrective and preventive solutions. Conduct regular inspections and performance assessments of animal care facilities and contractor services. Prepare animal welfare assessment reports, service improvement plans, and recommendations to enhance operational performance. Develop and implement animal training programs in coordination with relevant specialists. Monitor contractor performance against agreed service levels, contractual requirements, and animal care standards. Provide technical advice and professional recommendations to management regarding animal care operations and service improvements. Ensure appropriate emergency response procedures are established for animal health, safety, and welfare incidents. Qualifications and Experience Minimum of 8 years of relevant working experience in animal care, animal husbandry, veterinary health management, or animal welfare. Prior experience managing animal exhibits, VVIP animal farms, aquariums, and non-exotic farm animal facilities. Experience in managing and supervising animal care contractors and monitoring service delivery. Practical experience in assessing animal welfare, health, nutrition, behavior, and housing conditions. Experience in developing and reviewing animal care procedures, SOPs, assessment reports, and service improvement plans. Knowledge and experience in MEWA requirements governing animal resources, animal health, and welfare, or similar regulatory and compliance requirements in other countries. Experience in identifying operational and veterinary regulatory non-compliances and developing corrective action plans. Required Skills Strong knowledge of animal care, husbandry, veterinary health, and biosecurity management. Excellent organizational, leadership, communication, and reporting skills. Professional English communication skills are essential; Arabic language skills are an advantage. Work Location This role is based anywhere in Saudi Arabia, requiring oversight across various facilities.

cbce953947b04a02.description: About the Sales Representative Role Al-Watania Poultry (Saudi Arabia) is seeking a Sales Representative to join its team in Riyadh. This full-time position is crucial for achieving sales targets and expanding market reach for the company's products. The role requires a professional who can manage sales operations effectively while maintaining strong customer relationships. Key Responsibilities Implement monthly sales targets. Identify and create new sales avenues. Execute planned sales routes and submit reports to the supervisor. Deliver fresh products to distributors using refrigerated transport. Ensure product quality is maintained during the delivery process. Cultivate and maintain positive relationships with customers. Conduct daily supervision of distribution channels. Maintain consistent communication with customers. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 2 to 5 years of experience in a sales role. Proven ability to meet and exceed sales targets. Experience in route planning and reporting. Familiarity with product delivery and quality maintenance standards. Required Skills Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to build and maintain customer relationships. Organizational skills for route planning and reporting. Attention to detail, particularly in product quality assurance. cbcec03d6f09487d.description: About the Role Adecco Middle East is seeking an experienced Accounts Receivables Officer for a full-time position in Al Jubail. This role is crucial for managing day-to-day accounts payable operations, including invoice processing, vendor payments, reconciliations, and financial reporting. The ideal candidate will possess strong knowledge of accounting principles and hands-on experience with SAP/ERP systems. Key Responsibilities Manage the complete accounts payable cycle, including invoice matching, payment processing, and vendor reconciliations. Verify invoices against purchase orders, delivery notes, and supporting documentation. Prepare and process payments, ensuring compliance with company policies and approval procedures. Monitor outstanding payables and maintain accurate AP aging reports. Follow up with internal departments and vendors to resolve invoice discrepancies and payment-related issues. Maintain accurate financial records and ensure proper documentation of all transactions. Perform regular vendor account reconciliations and resolve discrepancies. Assist with monthly closing activities and prepare accounts payable reports. Maintain financial data using SAP/ERP systems and Microsoft Excel. Support internal and external audits by providing relevant financial records and documentation. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of experience in managing accounts payable operations. Strong knowledge of accounting principles. Hands-on experience with SAP/ERP systems. Advanced Excel skills. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Al Jubail, offering an opportunity to contribute to the financial operations of Adecco Middle East.

cbf1b5776ce33a05.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة أسترا الإنشاءات عن مساح كميات للانضمام إلى فريقها في العلا، المدينة المنورة. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية تقدير التكاليف وإدارة العقود ومراقبة الميزانية للمشاريع الإنشائية. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تقدير التكلفة لمشاريع الإنشاء ومباشرة تنفيذ العقود. تقييم أثر التغيرات ومراقبة الميزانية والإنفاق على المشاريع. الإبلاغ عن أي انحرافات في الموازنة وتقديم التحليلات اللازمة. وضع جداول الكميات وإعداد تقديرات التكاليف للمشاريع الهندسية. إدارة المناقصات والعقود قبل وبعد ترسيتها، ومباشرة المطالبات وعملية تغيير العقود. مقارنة التقدم المخطط له مع التقدم الفعلي في سير العمل، وتحليل الثغرات وتوضيح المخاطر. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشاريع الهندسية ونسب تقدمها وعرضها وتوضيحها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال مساحة الكميات أو ما يعادله. فهم قوي لعمليات تقدير التكاليف وإدارة العقود في المشاريع الإنشائية. القدرة على تحليل البيانات المالية وتقديم تقارير دقيقة. بيئة العمل يعمل مساح الكميات ضمن فريق شركة أسترا الإنشاءات في منطقة العلا بالمدينة المنورة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التزاماً كاملاً بمتطلبات المشروع وجداوله الزمنية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق شركة أسترا الإنشاءات، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم عبر القنوات المتاحة.

cb5ba49903cb2a49.description: About Accor and The Red Sea Project Accor is seeking a Head Baker for the Raffles & Fairmont The Red Sea properties. These resorts are part of the groundbreaking Red Sea Project, offering visitors a nature-focused experience with 361 rooms, eleven distinct dining concepts, and a spa. The location features 200km of untouched coastline, an archipelago of over 90 unspoiled islands, dormant volcanoes, rich marine habitats, and ancient archaeological sites, setting new standards in sustainable development. Role Summary The Head Baker will assist the Executive Pastry Chef in establishing and maintaining high culinary standards for the Bakery section at Raffles & Fairmont The Red Sea. This full-time role involves ensuring efficient operations, consistent product quality, and coordinating training for kitchen colleagues. The Head Baker will motivate the team to meet daily production requirements. Key Responsibilities Supervise colleagues in the Bakery section and report operational updates to the Executive Pastry Chef. Establish and maintain consistent bakery production standards aligned with hotel quality expectations. Inspect fresh food deliveries and food storage areas daily to ensure quality, proper storage, stock rotation, and compliance with Health & Safety regulations. Monitor daily food preparation, quality, quantities, inventory, portion control, and food costs. Oversee daily bakery production to ensure all products meet established quality and presentation standards. Coordinate with the Chief Steward to maintain high standards of cleanliness in the Bakery kitchen. Prepare weekly duty rosters, review staffing requirements, and manage overtime and holidays with the Executive Pastry Chef. Record accidents and sickness cases, reporting incidents to the Executive Chef / Executive Pastry Chef. Report machinery malfunctions promptly and ensure repairs are completed. Train colleagues on the correct and safe operation of kitchen equipment and ensure compliance with personal hygiene policies. Complete material and mise-en-place checklists and conduct daily inspections of the Bakery section. Review daily function sheets and coordinate bakery production accordingly. Ensure effective communication and proper handover between shifts, including adequate staffing for night operations. Plan and implement skills training programmes in coordination with the Training Manager. Assist in developing and standardizing bakery recipes for consistent quality and effective food cost control. Monitor operating expenses and implement corrective measures as needed. Identify guest preferences, market needs, and emerging bakery trends to enhance product offerings. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 years of relevant experience. Demonstrated ability to maintain high culinary standards and ensure product consistency. Experience in coordinating and delivering training for kitchen teams. Proficiency in monitoring food preparation, quality, inventory, and costs. Work Environment This role is based at the Raffles & Fairmont The Red Sea properties, which are situated within the Red Sea Project. The position is full-time, contributing to a resort committed to sustainable development and offering a unique natural setting.
